note: How a source becomes a slot set, what each export computes, and what the object draws. The applied cases are the ones that matter for the slot set: a port that survives an edit keeps the slot it had, so a link an operator made to a table cell outlives an edit to an unrelated line, and a source that does not parse never reaches the object at all. The displayed results are rounded to six significant digits the way Number(x.toPrecision(6)) rounds, and the one third case is where that shows.
